requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/groupBy.js` and your own tests in `tests/groupBy.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `groupBy(array, keyFn)` returning an object mapping each key (keyFn(item), converted to string) to the array of items in input order. keyFn must be a function, else TypeError.
